reason: As a solo CA with just one trainee, the two-seat free pilot already covers us, so I have no need to pay ₹12,990 upfront for seats I will not use. Having watched Jamku and desktop ERP get cluttered and abandoned after two months, I would never pay before a tool proves our trainee will actually stick with it.
objection: I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?
would_change_my_mind: If the free pilot automates my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation and my trainee actually sticks with it past two months without abandoning it.
